title: Bind controller readings to explicit local-player ownership

Neutralize removed devices without releasing their owners, require explicit reattachment and invalidate queued readings across device-ID reuse and backend restart; no automatic reassignment, idle/shared-user fallback or authentication claim

Use the verified input-snapshot profile read-only in a separate original SDK-facing adapter diagnostic; prove four distinct real provider devices reach the explicitly chosen owners, without embedding the provider or modifying current SDKs, fixtures, shared interfaces or guest services

Keep physical input, SDK input-system UI policy, mapping reloads, controls held before SDL first open and translated-title admission outside this bounded host-ingress result; MW3-083 and MW3-012 remain unpassed

Run repeated private Windows/Linux native, host-sanitizer and participating-library profiles with original virtual-device stimuli through the actual repaired SDK provider, checking normalized frames, held input, hotplug/reused IDs, late readings, explicit owner joins and bounded cleanup

Reconcile actual loaded libraries, exact source/compiler/configuration/receipt/binary/log identities and complete nonce-bound output; reject wrong routing, stale/partial/duplicate output and late children; run python tools/check.py and report performance/coverage limits
